main_text.l: {ASCIVA Musa cantica virgines Odere, blandas delicias Lyræ Arcent profanæ, non Poetam Pierij patiuntur antri Sacris adesse, & tollere Delphicas Æterna Lauros præmia, si probat Obscœnus incestos amores, Furta docens Veneris nefanda. Sunt hæc canoræ murmura tibiæ, Poppæe, Musis dulcia, Numinis Quæ facta supremi recensent, Vtque suum moderatur orbem, Seu sævientes sacrilega manu Cogat Gigantes regna Proserpinæ Vmbrasque pallentes adire, Fulminea metuendus arce: Seu copioso munere largior Fœcundat agros, lætáque pascuis Armenta nutrit, pacibúsque Agricolas recreat quietis. Sunt digna Phœbo, sunt Chariúm choris Iucunda, vates carmina quæ pius Castúsque

page.notes: The initial L is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as "ASCIVA" with the initial joined. The final word "Castúsque" continues on the next page. Faint show-through from the reverse page is disregarded.
